questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "brief".
questions.explanation: Brief means lasting a short time.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "honest".
questions.explanation: The prefix dis- reverses the meaning.

questions.question: One word for "a person who walks in his sleep":
questions.explanation: A somnambulist is a sleepwalker.

questions.question: One word for "fear of heights":
questions.explanation: Acrophobia is fear of heights.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: He lives ____ the river.
questions.explanation: "Near the river" is the natural phrase.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "ancient".
questions.explanation: Ancient means belonging to the distant past.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: She rarely ____ late.
questions.explanation: The third-person singular present takes "comes".

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "expand".
questions.explanation: To expand is to become larger; to shrink is the opposite.

questions.question: Find the error: Each of the students / were given / a book / by the teacher.
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, so "was given".

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "vacant".
questions.explanation: A vacant seat is an empty one.

questions.question: One word for "a person who loves books":
questions.explanation: A bibliophile loves books.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The news ____ good.
questions.explanation: "News" is uncountable and singular.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "victory".
questions.explanation: Defeat is the opposite of victory.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "hasten".
questions.explanation: To hasten is to hurry.

questions.question: One word for "a government by the people":
questions.explanation: Democracy means government by the people.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "optimistic".
questions.explanation: Pessimistic is the opposite.

questions.question: Find the error: He is / more taller / than his brother / by two inches.
questions.explanation: "Taller" is already comparative; "more" is redundant.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is good ____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The idiom is "good at".

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "abundant".
questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities.

questions.question: One word for "a speech delivered without preparation":
questions.explanation: An extempore speech is delivered without preparation.
